guard/30201.htm.text: Guard Pinaps: Oh! Nice to meet you, adventurer. What brings you here to the town of Oren? This town is surrounded by many dangerous areas, which place would you like to know about? The Sea of Spores is located to the northwest, the Ivory Tower to the north, the Tower of Oren to the northeast, and E…

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30201-1.htm.text: Guard Pinaps: The Enchanted Valley looks close on the map but is actually quite far. The entrances are located at the north and south, but the entrances are quite far from our town. Hunters who set up camps on the south eventually made their camps into a village... Legend tells... Well, do you know…

Q00251_NoSecrets/30201-01.htm.text: Guard Pinaps: We've learned Sel Mahums have begun training for battle. Their training grounds are near the Sel Mahum Training Grounds. This is no coincidence. The Town of Oren's safety is at stake. I won't just wait and see. I've sworn an oath to defend.

links.text: Ask about the Sel Mahum Training Grounds.

Q00251_NoSecrets/30201-00.htm.text: Guard Pinaps: I require a more seasoned adventurer. When you see one in the mirror, come on back. (Only character with level 82 or above can take on this quest.)

Q00251_NoSecrets/30201-05.htm.text: Guard Pinaps: Hey, lackey. While you're relaxing, Sel Mahums are training for war. That means get Ready!

Q00251_NoSecrets/30201-04.htm.text: Guard Pinaps: Excellent work! Now we know what kind of training the Sel Mahums are doing. Nicely done! Here, you've earned this!

Q00251_NoSecrets/30201-06.htm.text: Guard Pinaps: Ah, it has been awhile! Share a pint with me old friend! We can catch up on old times! (You have already performed this quest).

Q00290_ThreatRemoval/30201-01.htm.text: Guard Pinaps: I carefully inspected the Training Log and Schedule of the Sel Mahums, which you brought it last time. It looks like they are getting trained more systematically than I expected. I guess just finding out the information isn't enough... If their power gets stronger through this trainin…

Q00290_ThreatRemoval/30201-03.html.text: Guard Pinaps: Look recruit, I can't assign this mission to anyone who hasn't survived enough storms, you get me? (Only character with level 82 or above and who has performed the No Secret quest can take on this quest).

Q00290_ThreatRemoval/30201-04.html.text: Guard Pinaps: I'm not paying you by the hour! Let's go! You're not getting anything until I get my 400 Sel Mahum ID Tags.

Q00290_ThreatRemoval/30201-05.html.text: Guard Pinaps: You've done my job, the Town of Orean is safe. Thank you, defender... Please accept this gift for your help.

Q00251_NoSecrets/30201-02.htm.text: Guard Pinaps: Ah, these lands were once called SkyPaint Grassland. Then the Sel Mahums put their training camp here and dubbed it the Sel Mahum Training Grounds. Anyway, what do you think? Want to give me a hand?

Q00251_NoSecrets/30201-03.htm.text: Guard Pinaps: The Sel Mahums are training for war, it's up to us to keep the peace. But we need to know more about their training operation. I cannot leave my post, I'm duty bound. I'll need your help. Get the Sel Mahum training schedule from the training instructor and bring it here. Then bring th…

Q00290_ThreatRemoval/30201-02.html.text: Guard Pinaps: The mission is simple: Kill them. The recruits, the instructors, every Sel Mahum you find in the Sel Mahum Training Grounds. They cannot be allowed to continue their training. Gather over 400 Sel Mahum tags and bring them to me. I will reward you.., I know you fight for more than hono…

Q00290_ThreatRemoval/30201-06.html.text: Guard Pinaps: Like it or not, this is the best I can get right now. I may be able to do better next time. What do you think? Still game?

links.text: Say you will continue to help.

Q00290_ThreatRemoval/30201-07.html.text: Guard Pinaps: Thanks. I was really hoping you'd say that. When this is over we may share a pint. For now, we carry out the mission. Get rid of those Sel Mahums at the Sel Mahum Training Grounds, and bring more than 400 Sel Mahum tags as evidence. You will be rewarded.

Q00290_ThreatRemoval/30201-08.html.text: Guard Pinaps: I need your help. But unlike me, you are not duty bound, mercenary. Stay or leave. I will not grovel.

Q00290_ThreatRemoval/30201-09.html.text: Guard Pinaps: Oh, it is. So be it. I respect your skills. May we serve together again someday.

Q00290_ThreatRemoval/30201-10.html.text: Guard Pinaps: You're sharp and determined. I think we make a great team. I hope we can work together again.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
